description: This file defines a utility class 'JsLanguageFilesMappingUtil' that provides static methods to access language file mappings for different JavaScript libraries and frameworks based on locale strings. It uses a switch statement to route the request to appropriate mapping classes.

classes.name: JsLanguageFilesMappingUtil
classes.description: Provides static utility methods to retrieve language file paths for various JavaScript libraries based on the library name and locale string.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Returns the file path of a language mapping for a given library and locale. Uses a switch statement to select the appropriate mapping class.
